title: Jesus Said Love Everyone
description: A musical video with lyrics and images for the children's song "Jesus Said Love Everyone."
content:
Lovingly
Jesus said love ev’ryone;
Treat them kindly too.
When your heart is filled with love,
Others will love you.
Words and music:
Moiselle Renstrom, 1889–1956
Matthew 5:43–46
Matthew 22:37–39
John 13:34–35
